description: Fibre backhaul between eNB_INC2 and the aggregation router was severed. All traffic on INC2_CELL_B was lost for the full ROP period. PMCELLDOWNTIMEAUTO=86400s.
Cell completely unavailable — availability dropped to 0%. No UE could attach during this window.
CELLBARRED set to 1 and ADMINISTRATIVESTATE set to 0 following a CM push on 2026-06-27. Accessibility dropped from 99.88% to 51.12% on the following day.
DL interference elevated on eNB_INC3. All three co-site cells affected simultaneously — consistent with external interference source. Throughput dropped from 100 kbps baseline to 35 kbps.
Co-site interference on eNB_INC3 affecting INC3_CELL_C2 in parallel with C1 and C3. No local CM changes — confirming interference as root cause.
Co-site interference on eNB_INC3. Throughput degradation observed across all three cells sharing the same eNodeB.

EN-DC setup success rate fell from 98% baseline to 55% on 2026-06-30. NR Random Access failures are the likely cause. LTE anchor cell INC4_LTE_ANCHOR remains healthy — confirms the issue is in the 5G NSA layer only.
Routine software upgrade on eNB_INC1. Cell returned to service at 04:00Z with no KPI impact observed on subsequent days.
Brief power fluctuation at site eNB_INC2 — rectifier unit cycled. No significant downtime recorded (less than 1 second of PMCELLDOWNTIMEAUTO).
X2 interface between INC4_LTE_ANCHOR and a neighbouring eNB experienced elevated latency. Handover success temporarily reduced. No cell availability impact.
